RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  July 30, 2010/Sravana 8, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Human Resource Development; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
26
Freight charges for De-oiled Rice
Bran
*81. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Minister for Food, Civil
Supplies and Animal Husbandry of the
State Government of Kerala has requested
the Minister for the classification of De-
oiled Rice Bran, an important raw material
for the production of cattle feed from class
120 to class 90, in line with classification
of fodder or under classification 100 along
with other De-oiled meals, so that Kerala
Feeds Limited, a State PSU engaged in
production of cattle feed, can reduce the
freight charges and thereby reduce the
manufacturing cost of the cattle feed; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's decision thereon?
Production of milk
*82. SHRI R.C. S INGH: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of production of milk in
the country, State-wise;
(b) the details of consumption of milk
in the country, State-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that due to
shortage of milk in the country, its price is
going up;
(d) to what extent the National Project
for Cattle and Buffalo Breeding (NPCBB)
is helping in improving production of milk
in the country;
(e) what efforts the Ministry is making
to keep the price of milk at an affordable
level; and
(f) whether it is also a fact that in view
of just 7 per cent increase in the population
of cows, there is not much scope for
increase in production of milk in the
country?
Attempts of sabotage in trains
*83. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry has taken note
of the incident in which brake pipe of
Nilambur-Shoranur passenger train was
found sawed at Nilambur station;

27
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether the Ministry has also taken
note of the incident in which explosives
were recovered in Ernakulam-
Thiruvananthapuram V anchinad Express;
(c) if so, what is the progress of the
investigation;
(d) whether there is any confirmation
of suspected hand of external elements
behind the incidents; and
(e) the steps taken by the Railways to
strengthen the security systems at railway
stations and trains in Kerala in the wake of
these sabotage attempts?
Scam in Railway recruitment
examination
†*84. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that large-scale
malpractices took place in the examination
held on 6 and 13 June, 2010 for the
recruitment of Assistant Station Masters
and Loco Pilots;
(b) if so, the number of people arrested
so far in this case; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government so as to avert recurrence of
such incidents in future?
Construction of office of Navodaya
Vidyalaya Samiti
†*85. SHRI A VINASH RAI
KHANNA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether according to the
Comptroller and Auditor General's (CAG)
report, Government has suffered a loss of
Rs. 2.5 crores due to non-completion of
the office of Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti
on time;
(b) if so, whether Government would
punish the officers responsible therefor;
(c) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor; and
(d) the plan of Government to avoid
recurrence of such losses in future?
Interruption of rail services due to
bandhs/strikes
*86. SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the scheduled arrival/
departure of a large number of trains was
affected due to the bandhs/strikes during
2010;
(b) if so, the details thereof, zone-wise;
(c) the details of loss suffered by
Railways due to cancellation and delay of
trains during the said period, zone-wise;
(d) whether Railways have taken
remedial measures to deal with such
situations, to avoid cancellation and delays;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Elections of Executive Council of AMU
*87. SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for the elections of the
Executive Council of Aligarh Muslim
University not being held;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
has given direction to the University not to
do so;

28
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether Government would ensure
holding of the elections immediately?
Semester System in Delhi University
*88. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Delhi
University has introduced Semester System
of examination for its various courses;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that Delhi
University Teachers' Association (DUTA)
has been protesting against introduction of
Semester System; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, the reasons
therefor and Government's reaction
thereto?
Development of infrastructure in
agriculture sector
*89. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to initiate any ambitious
programme to develop infrastructure in
agriculture;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise
including Gujarat State;
(c) the details of employment
opportunities likely to be generated in this
sector;
(d) whether Government is likely to
take full care of the financial aspects; and
(e) if so, the foreign exchange likely to
be earned?
Purchase of adulterated wheat for FCI
by PUNSUP
*90. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA : W ill the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether, on behalf of Food
Corporation of India (FCI), Punjab
procurement agency, namely the Punjab
State Civil Supplies Corporation Limited
(PUNSUP), has purchased grains which
contain 20 per cent wheat and 80 per cent
mud;
(b) if so, whether FCI has taken any
action in this regard and whether it
proposes to lift the stock of grains after
physical verification;
(c) if so, whether the procurement
norms of FCI would be revised and agencies
which are trying to supply highly toxic
and adulterated grains would be blacklisted;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Network of touts in railways
*91. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry is aware of
recent media reports (May-June 2010)
wherein it has been stated that railway
reservation in general and HOR quota in
particular is under the strangle hold of touts
and middlemen due to their connivance with
departmental staff;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that a large
number of touts, without-ticket-travellers
and transferred-ticket-travellers have been
apprehended in different zones and

29
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
divisions during the last three months;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof, zone-wise
and division-wise?
Damage to rice, wheat and cereals of
FCI
*92. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that thousands of
sacks containing wheat, rice and cereals
belonging to the Food Corporation of India
(FCI) got drenched in rain and thereby got
damaged;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for not keeping the sacks
in proper condition and under protection;
(d) whether any responsibility has been
fixed for this negligence; and
(e) if so, the action taken against the
defaulters and the steps taken to prevent
recurrence of such incidents?
Admission of poor students in public
schools in Delhi
†*93. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the number and details of those
public schools in Delhi which have not
allotted 10 per cent of their seats to poor
students despite Government's direction;
(b) whether action has been taken by
Government against the erring public
schools;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Implementation of National Food
Security Act
*94. SHRI M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether any assessment has been
made about the amount the Government is
going to spend if foodgrains are distributed
@ 35 kg. per family/per month and 25 kg.
per family/per month under the proposed
National Food Security Act;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to implement the above scheme
as per the figures of BPL families given by
the Tendulkar Committee; and
(d) if so, the details of BPL families,
State-wise?
Suicide by farmers
†*95. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether State Governments have
reported about the suicides committed by
farmers during the past six months;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?

30
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Teacher training institutes
*96. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Min ister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Council for
Teacher Education (NCTE) has submitted
a report to Government on the status of
teacher training institutes in the country;
(b) if so, the details of the report
submitted by NCTE;
(c) whether it has been found that many
of the teacher training institutes have refused
to be inspected by NCTE and many such
institutes are existing on paper only; and
(d) if so, the steps Government has
initiated to ensure proper functioning of
teacher training institutes in the country?
Appointment of class III and IV
employees in railways
*97. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Railway
General Managers (GMs) have the power
to appoint 200 class III and IV employees
before their retirement;
(b) the number of GMs who have retired
in last three years and how many class III
and class IV employees have been
appointed by them; and
(c)whether the power of appointment
without interview delegated to GM,
Railways is by Legislation or Government
order or it is only a convention?
Inspection of private universities
†*98. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had constituted a committee in 2009 for
inspection of the universities established
by the private sector in the country;
(b) if so, the facts thereof and the names
of the members appointed in the committee
along with their qualifications with regard
to the administration of the universities;
and
(c) the total number of universities
inspected by this committee along with the
total number of universities found ineligible
and whether the committee has classified
the ineligible universities?
Online PDS scheme
*99. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is planning to
transfer food entitlements to ration card
holders through an electronic system once
the Public Distribution System (PDS) is
linked to Unique ID or Aadhar's central
data repository;
(b) if so, the salient features of the
proposed online scheme; and
(c) to what extent the fake ration card-
holders/beneficiaries are likely to be
unearthed by this online PDS scheme?

31
'PAU 201' a new rice variety
*100. SARDAR SUKH DEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has directed
the Food Corporation of India (FCI) to
buy out bulk of the harvest from the 'PAU
201', a new variety of rice, which was
damaged to the extent of over eight per
cent in Punjab; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 24th July, 2010 Secretary-General.
Sravana 2, 1932 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
